text:
kiara: Proposal — add an explicit header `X-Namespace` to drive routing + quota scoping. Less guesswork than inferring from API key claims. Thoughts?
jamal: Curious — is this for routing only or also billing/quota?
sara: Both, ideally. Routing + quotas + telemetry label. If we decouple from `org`/`project` claims we can support cross-org service accounts more cleanly.
ops-mike: Billing team will want a clear mapping. If namespace != billing project, we need a lookup table. That adds ops churn.
kiara: Yeah agreed. My idea: default namespace comes from key claims, but `X-Namespace` can override when explicit (with audit/inspect log). For override we record who set it.
jamal: Backcompat concern: customers using existing API keys today — we must preserve current routing. Any header override should be behind a feature flag and opt-in.
sara: +1. Also need clear telemetry so alerts and dashboards show whether requests used the override header. Metrics tag: `namespace`, `namespace_override` boolean, and `key_id`.
ops-mike: How would the header look in practice? Example?
kiara:
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: ApiKey abcd1234" -H "X-Namespace: marketing-team-42" https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```
jamal: Nice. For security, if `X-Namespace` is supplied by client we must validate key has permission to impersonate that namespace. Otherwise it's an escalation.
sara: Exactly. Validation step: check key's allowed namespace list, or require a new claim `can_assume_namespaces` in the token. If override used and key lacks claim -> 403 + audit event.
ops-mike: Quota model: do we charge against the namespace quota or the billing project tied to the key? We need deterministic rule.
kiara: Proposal: routing and soft-quota applied to `namespace`. Billing still resolves to the key's billing_project unless tenant opts into namespace-billing. This lets teams stage before full billing migration.
jamal: That hybrid model makes rollouts easier. But we must expose this clearly in Console and billing export.
sara: UX: Console dropdown for "Request namespace override" with a warning: "Only available for keys with namespace-assume claim". Also list last 30 days of overrides in request logs.
ops-mike: Telemetry note: add a new metric dimension `namespace_source` = {claim, header_override, default}. Pager rules need to consider noisy override traffic.
kiara: Implementation plan (rough):
- API gateway accepts `X-Namespace` header and attaches `namespace_source` meta
- Auth service authorizes override and emits audit event
- Routing layer uses namespace to select model shard/pool
- Quota service applies soft limits at namespace, hard limits on billing_project until opt-in
- Console shows override usage & a rollout toggle behind `namespace-routing-v2`

jamal: Rollout: start with canary in `us-west-2` for orgs flagged in `namespace-routing-beta`. Monitor `auth.failures`, `quota.charges`, and `billing.explainable_mismatch`.
sara: Also need logs for `unauthorized-namespace-override` with sample payload: `{"key_id":"K_123","attempted_namespace":"X","remote_ip":"..."}`. Add to SLO for auth latency (auth path must still be <30ms p95).
ops-mike: Billing exports: add `namespace_resolved` and `namespace_overrode` fields to line item CSVs. Finance will hate but will survive. :grimacing:
kiara: Edge case: service accounts used by infra jobs where namespace is intentionally different for multi-tenant routing. We should allow a `namespace-audit` header that is only logged and not used for routing in canary phases.
jamal: Good idea — a `X-Namespace-Audit-Only` that only annotates telemetry. No routing impact until we flip the flag.
sara: Security review: ensure that proxies and SDKs can't inject header accidentally. We'll need gateway-level whitelist and SDK guidance. Also rotate-old-keys behavior shouldn't lose binding.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: namespace-routing-v2 flag -> rollout-start (canary 5% traffic) at 2026-04-01T16:00Z.
ops-mike: Preflight checks: verify metric `namespace_override_rate` exists and dashboard has baseline, add alert if spike > 3x baseline in 15m.
kiara: Action items: @jamal build auth validation + audit event, @sara add telemetry tags & dashboard widgets, @ops-mike coordinate billing export fields, I'll draft console copy and canary plan.
jamal: Taking auth validation task. Will PR w/ tests for `can_assume_namespaces` claim check.
sara: I'll add Prometheus labels and Grafana panel skeleton.
ops-mike: I'll open billing ticket and add export columns.
kiara: Ok team — let's keep the header idea but strict by default. Conservative rollout. :thumbsup:
jamal: one more thought — rate limiting: should we rate-limit on namespace or on key? Probably both: per-key first, then namespace-tier.
kiara: yep per-key then namespace global banding. Documenting in design doc. Will post link shortly.
sara: Thanks. Also add a FAQ entry: "Why not just use org from key claims?" -> short answer: inference clients sometimes need ephemeral routing and we want explicit intent + audit.
ops-mike: Fine. If we detect high override usage we can require an org admin to opt in for that org.
kiara: Cool. I'll follow up with PRs and the console copy."
